does: Opens a round of pita and spreads a thin layer of raw, spiced meat mixture inside, then presses the bread shut, so that the filling cooks and the bread crisps and soaks up its juices on the heat.
how: Cut round the edge of the pita with a knife, or split it along one side, and open it into layers.
Spread the filling thinly and evenly over the inner face of one layer, right to the edge.
Close the pita over the filling and press it down firmly with the hand, so that the layers hold together.
Cut it in half, or leave it whole, and cook it at once.

cues.text: The filling lies flat and even, with none showing at the edge.
The closed bread is firm and flat under the hand, and does not slide apart.

mistakes.mistake: Piling the filling thick in the middle, so that the bread crisps and burns before the filling is done.
mistakes.fix: Spread it thin, as thin as a finger, and even.

mistakes.mistake: Using a dry, cracked pita that splits as it is opened.
mistakes.fix: Warm the bread first, so that it bends.

variant_of.differs: The pocket is a round of bread, and the filling is raw meat spread flat as a thin layer and pressed shut so that it cooks with the bread. It is not packed into a hollow of a bird or a vegetable.
